messages.subject: For Christian Bruch | Grid infrastructure, energy transition and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Siemens Energy Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Christian Bruch, Chief Executive Officer.

Siemens Energy's role in grids, generation and the global energy transition places government relations, regulation, infrastructure investment and stakeholder confidence at the center of execution. Those priorities align closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and battery-storage program.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and energy-infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Siemens Energy's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Siemens Energy.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
